**New name in the stores:** Detour: Nebula & Floatplane for YouTube. The toolbar and popup still say Detour.

### What's new
- **Nebula podcasts:** when a YouTube upload is also a Nebula podcast episode, Detour links to the episode. A video match still wins over a podcast episode.
- **Many more matches:** the known-videos list now covers every Nebula channel (384, up from 148), all 51 Nebula podcasts, and older uploads. That's 31,000+ YouTube videos matched, up from about 1,300.
- **Floatplane creators come from Detour's own list,** which updates daily without a new release. If Floatplane's own creator list can be loaded, it's merged in.

### Changes
- Removed the bundled list of Floatplane creators. Subscriptions you saved earlier still work.
- If no creator list can be loaded, the settings popup says so instead of showing an out-of-date list.
- Shorter store summary.

**Install:** [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/detour/lofobnkomhhicgcpejnlcibekkaiaeed), or load the zip below.
